svg.title: From link to pixels
svg.desc: Opening one slice of the sample brain MRI. 1: the link carries, after the #, the URL of bundle.jwe and a 32-byte key. 2: the browser fetches bundle.jwe (59 KB) and decrypts it with the link key; it holds a Patient, six DiagnosticReports and six ImagingStudy resources. 3: the MRI's ImagingStudy names one encrypted file for the whole study, with its key, and lists every series and the byte length of every instance. Series 16 (T2 FSE AX) comes after 9 series that together take 8,768,688 bytes; adding instances 1 to 10 of series 16 gives 12,300,546, the offset in the study file where instance 11 starts, and instance 11 is 353,408 bytes long, its pixels stored as lossless JPEG. 4: the study file is 28,584,796 bytes, 437 records of 64 KiB; series 16 lies in records 133 to 240, and instance 11 in records 187 to 193. 5: one request with Range: bytes=12255232-12713983 is answered 206 Partial Content with 458,752 bytes, 7 records. 6: a Web Worker checks each record's GCM tag, decrypts, cuts out the instance, decodes its lossless JPEG pixels in WebAssembly, and WebGL2 applies the window and level. 7: the slice is drawn.
svg.text: After the #, so never sent to a server
One file for the study, and its key
then every series, with instance lengths
